BiblicalUsage: Mordecai is the Jew of the captivity who raises his cousin Esther and uncovers the plot against the king. He ends the book second to the king himself, seeking the wealth of his people and speaking peace to all his seed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mordecai is the quiet man of the whole story: he does the faithful thing in the shadows, and God turns it into the saving of a nation.
